features: Immersive 5.25-Inch Woofer for Theater-Grade Bass: Experience powerful, room-filling bass with a high-performance 5.25-inch subwoofer, engineered to deliver deep, cinematic sound that transforms your living space into a home theatre. Whether you're watching action-packed blockbusters, enjoying Dolby Atmos content, or immersed in surround sound gaming, this subwoofer offers rich, low-frequency resonance perfect for any entertainment setup.

Dynamic RGB Ambient Lighting: Elevate your movie nights with built-in syncable LED ambient lighting, designed to provide theater-style RGB backlighting. Not only does it enhance visual appeal, but it also helps reduce eye strain in dark environments, making your home entertainment experience more immersive and visually comfortable.

Versatile Playback Options (USB/AUX/TF Card: Enjoy uninterrupted media playback through multiple inputs like USB, AUX, and TF Card, while also supporting Bluetooth streaming, HDMI ARC, and optical input for modern 4K TVs, soundbars, and gaming consoles. Fully compatible with Dolby Digital and other lossless audio formats, it ensures high-quality sound with every connection.

Crystal-Clear Audio with Enhanced Surround Sound: Equipped with high-fidelity drivers, this system produces clear vocals, crisp highs, and well-balanced lows, making it ideal for streaming from platforms like Netflix, Prime Video, or playing Blu-ray discs. Enhanced surround sound ensures an enveloping audio environment that captures every nuance.

Compact Yet Powerful Home Theatre Speaker: Designed with a space-saving footprint, this speaker packs THX-certified sound into a compact form, offering bass reflex technology for superior acoustics. It's ideal for small to medium-sized rooms, gaming stations, or long movie sessions, delivering professional-grade audio without taking up excess space.
